entities.name: Herberts Vasiļjevs
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Herberts Vasiļjevs is a retired Latvian professional ice hockey center and right winger. He played in 51 NHL contests and spent more than ten years in the German DEL with Krefeld Pinguine. He also represented the Latvian national teams at three Olympic Games.
